aesthetic: Helvetica Grid — a Swiss typographic system where alignment tension and whitespace density carry all visual weight, the page itself as the only ornament
chromaticArc: All 44 slides rest on Warm Paper (#F8F5F0); exactly 3 structural chapter-break slides shift to Warm Ash (#E8E3DB) as a mid-tone ground, signalling section transitions without breaking the luminous, paper-like register of the deck.
gridStrategy: Titles anchor at col 6 span 26–28 on all slides; body text runs col 6 span 34–36; the right third (cols 42–60) is permanent whitespace — the only zone variation is vertical: title rows drop from row 10 on openers to row 8 on data-heavy slides to create a tighter top margin for denser content.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: No secondary font is used; all slides render in Helvetica Neue at varying weights (300–400) and sizes — typographic hierarchy is achieved through scale and tracking alone, never through typeface switching

accentStrategy: No decorative elements; the sole structural mark is a 1px horizontal rule in Steel Warm (#8A8680) used once per chapter-break slide as a baseline separator below the section label — never decorative, always load-bearing.
